transmit_beamforming_5ghz.reason: The live kernel disables MT76x2 AP TXBF. This router's Factory TXBF calibration regions at 0x01A0 and 0x81A0 are each 33/33 bytes FF, so RC sets wl_txbf_en=0 and writes ETxBfEnCond=0 even when wl_txbf=1. Generic chipset detection alone must not expose the control.

multi_user_mimo_5ghz.reason: MT7612 in this board is a 2x2 802.11ac Wave 1 radio: no MU-MIMO. The live device keeps wl_mumimo unset and the earlier WebUI still rendered a row_mumimo control, which is misleading next to the disabled TXBF policy.

roaming_24ghz.scope: next build requests k/r/v code; compiled image and physical behavior still require verification
roaming_24ghz.reason: MT7603E includes RRM, WNM/BTM and FT source paths. Next-build options select all three; image gate requires their linked handlers and defaults remain off. Historical live #474 omits these options.

roaming_5ghz.scope: k/r objects selected; 802.11v build path and actual management frames/client behavior unverified
roaming_5ghz.reason: RRM/FT source selection is not runtime acceptance. WNM source exists but its normal mt76x2_ap Makefile inclusion was not found. The duplicate generator fix does not prove k/v/r operation.
